detailed_descriptions.en: Dark Light: Survivor is a roguelike survival game where you play as one of the last humans, journeying through a shattered multiverse in search of the fabled Elysium. The Dark Void has unleashed horrific creatures that decimated humanity and fractured the multiverse. Amidst this chaos, a legend speaks of an Elysium untouched by the darkness. The remnants of humanity have uncovered celestial quantum technology, using it to construct the Phantom Train, capable of traversing the multiverse. As a Dark Hunter, you are aboard the Phantom Train, hoping to reach Elysium. In each universe, you must collect energy to power the train for the next leap. Prepare yourself to face increasingly terrifying and powerful creatures, for the journey is perilous, and Elysium remains elusive. FEATURES Dynamic Perspective Shifts: Swap between top down and third person view at any time. Command the battlefield from above or move in close for immersive combat, precise aiming, and devastating headshots. Roguelike Progression Every run is a fight for survival. Gather resources, unlock permanent upgrades, discover powerful new weapons and items, and push deeper into increasingly brutal worlds. Distinct Biomes Cross three deadly worlds, a ruined town consumed by demons and cybernetic horrors, cursed castle ruins swallowed by the Dark Void, and a frozen battlefield where giant insect beasts roam among the wreckage of ancient warships. Artifacts and Skills Master 3 unique classes, each with distinct skills, strengths, and upgrade paths. Unlock Artifacts, earn permanent bonuses, and build your loadout with new starting weapons and abilities every run. Pixel Mode & Cinematic Graphics: Switch between cinematic 4K visuals and a nostalgic Pixel Mode that evokes classic indie games. Pixel Mode isn’t just a visual change.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Dark Light: Survivor》是一款 Roguelike 生存游戏。你将扮演人类最后的幸存者之一，穿越破碎的多元宇宙，寻找传说中的极乐之地 Elysium。 黑暗虚空释放出骇人的怪物，几乎毁灭了人类，并撕裂了整个多元宇宙。在这片混乱之中，流传着一个传说：有一处名为 Elysium 的净土，从未被黑暗侵蚀。 人类残存的势力发现了天体量子科技，并利用它建造出能够穿梭多元宇宙的“幻影列车”。 作为一名 Dark Hunter，你正身处这辆幻影列车之上，怀抱着抵达 Elysium 的希望前行。在每一个宇宙中，你都必须收集能量，为列车的下一次跃迁提供动力。做好准备，迎接越来越可怕、越来越强大的怪物。这段旅程危机四伏，而 Elysium 依旧遥不可及。 游戏特色 • 动态视角切换： 可随时在俯视视角与第三人称视角之间切换。既可从上方掌控战场全局，也可贴近战斗，体验更具沉浸感的近距离交锋、精准瞄准与致命爆头。 • 肉鸽（Roguelike) 成长机制： 每一局都是一场生死之战。收集资源，解锁永久升级，发现更强大的武器与道具，并不断深入愈发残酷的世界。 • 独特生态区域： 穿越三个致命世界：被恶魔与机械怪物吞噬的废墟小镇，被黑暗虚空侵蚀的诅咒城堡遗迹，以及巨型虫兽游荡于古代战舰残骸之间的冰封战场。 • 神器与技能： 掌握 3 个独特职业，每个职业都拥有不同的技能、优势与成长路线。解锁神器，获得永久加成，并在每一局中用全新的初始武器与能力打造属于你的战斗构筑。 • 像素模式与电影级画质： 在电影级 4K 画面与唤起经典独立游戏情怀的像素模式之间自由切换。像素模式不只是视觉上的变化。
